services.0.detail.3: Buto yo kukwandikira n'amahuza y'imbuga nkoranyambaga

services.1.long: Landing page cyangwa umwirondoro w'ikigo bifasha ubucuruzi gutanga isura nziza ku nshuro ya mbere. Dutegura uko urupapuro rukurikirana, ibyanditswe n'isura kugira ngo abasura basobanukirwe vuba ibyo utanga kandi bumve bashaka kukwandikira.
services.1.detail.0: Ibyanditswe ku rupapuro bisobanutse kandi bishimisha

services.1.detail.4: Gutangira vuba ibikoresho byawe nibimara kuboneka
services.1.for: Ubucuruzi, amashuri, kafe, imiryango n'ibigo bishaka isura y'umwuga.
services.2.long: Sisitemu y'amakuru ikosora akazi gasanzwe gatataniye muri spreadsheets, inyandiko n'ubutumwa. Amakuru aba ahantu hamwe, agakoreshwa hakurikijwe inshingano, kandi raporo zikaboneka igihe cyose.
services.2.detail.0: Uburyo bw'akazi busobanutse bukurikiza uko ukora
services.2.detail.4: Ahantu h'ubuyobozi ho gucunga ibikubiyemo ubwawe
services.2.for: Amashuri, ibigo, amaduka, ubworozi n'ibigo bishaka gucunga amakuru mu buryo buteguye neza.
services.3.long: Imirimo isubirwamo nko kohereza ubutumwa, kwimura amakuru hagati ya porogaramu cyangwa gukora raporo zisanzwe ishobora gukora yonyine. Itsinda ryawe rizigama igihe kandi rikirinda amakosa yo kwandika.
services.3.detail.1: Ubutumwa bwikora kuri WhatsApp cyangwa kuri imeyili
services.3.detail.2: Inzira zikora zonyine zo kwemeza no gutanga raporo
services.3.for: Ubucuruzi n'amatsinda bifite imirimo myinshi isubirwamo bakora n'intoki.
process.0.long: Mbere yo kubaka ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose, dushaka gusobanukirwa ubucuruzi bwawe: intego ni iyihe, abasura ni bande, n'imikorere ikomeye cyane ni iyihe. Aho ni ho dutangira gushyira ibigomba kubanza kugira ngo akazi gahore kibanze kandi hirindwe ibyakoreshwa nta mpamvu.
process.0.do.2: Guhitamo imikorere y'ingenzi n'uko akazi gakurikirana
process.0.you: Tubwire ibyo ukeneye usangize n'ingero z'imbuga ukunda.
process.1.long: Duhera ku gutegura imiterere y'impapuro n'ishusho y'isura. Ushobora kubisuzuma ugatanga ibitekerezo mbere y'uko dutangira kubaka, bityo igisubizo cya nyuma kigahora hafi y'ibyo wari witeze.
process.1.you: Suzuma igishushanyo, hanyuma utange ibitekerezo cyangwa wemeze.
process.1.result: Igishushanyo twemeranyijeho mbere y'uko dutangira gukora.
process.2.long: Igishushanyo nikimara kwemezwa, urubuga, porogaramu cyangwa ikoranabuhanga ryikora biraba. Bihuza na telefoni na mudasobwa, kandi ushobora gutanga ibitekerezo akazi kagikorwa.
process.2.do.1: Kwemeza ko bisa neza kuri telefoni, tablet na mudasobwa
process.2.do.2: Gutegura ibya ngombwa kugira ngo ubonwe byoroshye kuri Google
process.2.do.3: Gusangiza amakuru y'aho akazi kageze buri gihe
process.2.you: Tegura inyandiko, amafoto n'ibirango, kandi utange ibitekerezo igihe ubifite.
process.2.result: Verisiyo ya mbere ushobora kugerageza. Urubuga rworoheje rurangira akenshi mu minsi 1–3 y'akazi ibikoresho bimaze kuboneka.
process.3.long: Tugerageza igisubizo hamwe. Icyo kitaranoga neza kirakosorwa, hanyuma byose bikongera bikageragezwa kugeza bikora neza ku bikoresho bitandukanye kandi byiteguye gutangizwa.
process.3.do.0: Kugenzura isura ku bunini butandukanye bwa ecran
process.3.you: Gerageza igisubizo maze utubwire icyo wifuza ko gihindurwa.
process.4.long: Igicuruzwa kiratangazwa kigafungurirwa buri wese. Tugitegura kugira ngo kibonwe byoroshye kuri Google, hanyuma tukaguha uburenganzira bwo kugikoresha hamwe n'ubuyobozi bw'imikoreshereze kugira ngo ugicunge nta kibazo.
process.4.do.2: Gutanga uburenganzira bwo gukoresha n'ubuyobozi bw'imikoreshereze
process.4.do.3: Kugushyigikira n'ubufasha bw'ubuntu mu mwaka 1, hiyongereyeho domaine (Ipaki Nto) cyangwa hosting (Ipaki Nini)
process.4.you: Bika uburenganzira bwawe ahantu hizewe maze utangire kubusangiza abakiriya bawe.
process.4.result: Urubuga cyangwa porogaramu byatangijwe kandi biteguye gukoreshwa.

faq.title: Ibibazo bikunze kuvuka mbere yo gutangira.
faq.description: Niba ikibazo cyawe kitasubijwe hano, inama zishobora gufasha kumenya ibyo ukeneye.
faq.0.question: Ni serivisi ki Nocoding ishobora gukora?
faq.0.answer: Dukora imbuga za portfolio cyangwa CV bwite, landing page cyangwa umwirondoro w'ikigo, sisitemu z'amakuru n'imikorere, n'ikoranabuhanga ryikora mu mikorere y'ubucuruzi.
faq.1.question: Gukora bifata igihe kingana iki?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio bwite, CV cyangwa landing page yoroheje akenshi bifata iminsi 1-3 y'akazi ibikoresho bimaze kuboneka. Imishinga minini biterwa n'imikorere ikenewe, uburyo bwo guhuza n'uko ibitekerezo bitangwa.
faq.2.question: Igishushanyo n'imikorere bishobora guhindurwa?
faq.2.answer: Yego. Igishushanyo, imiterere y'impapuro, imikorere n'inzira z'akazi bishobora guhindurwa bihuye n'ibyo ukeneye. Igishushanyo gisuzumirwa hamwe mbere y'uko dutangira gukora.
faq.3.question: Igiciro gikubiyemo iki?
faq.3.answer: Igiciro gikubiyemo gukora hakurikijwe ipaki n'ibyemeranyijweho. Ipaki Nto irimo ubufasha na domaine ku buntu mu mwaka 1, naho Ipaki Nini ikaba irimo ubufasha na hosting ku buntu mu mwaka 1.
contact.title: Tubwire ibyo urubuga rwawe rukeneye. Tuzagufasha koroshya inzira.
contact.description: Ohereza incamake ngufi y'ubucuruzi bwawe, impapuro ushaka n'igihe wifuza. Igisubizo cya mbere kizaba kirimo inama ku bijyanye n'ibigomba gukorwa n'intambwe zikurikira. Inama ni iz'ubuntu buri gihe, igihe cyose ukeneye.
footer.tagline: Imbuga z'ubucuruzi ziteguye gutangira, zisa neza kandi zoroshye kuzamura.
project.description.ecoswap: Isoko rya interineti ryo kugura no kugurisha ibikoresho byakoreshejwe. Abantu bashobora kubishyiraho, kubishakisha no kubigura byoroshye kuri telefoni cyangwa kuri mudasobwa.
project.description.wiboost: Iduka rya interineti rya serivisi za digitale nko kongera amafaranga mu mikino, ipaki za data na porogaramu zihenze, rifite amafaranga y'abakiriya na gahunda y'abagurisha bundi bushya.
project.description.ahawi: Urubuga rwa portfolio bwite rufite isura y'ibishushanyo by'amazi mu ndimi ebyiri, rwo kwerekana umwirondoro, uburambe n'uko wavugana na nyirarwo.
project.description.abdi: Sisitemu y'inyandiko y'abakozi bo mu ngoro (abdi dalem) ya Keraton ya Surakarta: kwiyandikisha, amakuru bwite, gahunda y'ibikorwa, kwitaba no gucapa amakarita y'indangamuntu.
project.description.sfarm: Porogaramu yo gucunga ubworozi bw'inkoko zitera amagi n'ihene bwa kimwe mu midugudu: inyandiko za buri munsi, ibyagurishijwe, ibyakoreshejwe na raporo z'imari.
project.description.payu: Urubuga ruhuza abatanga imirimo n'abikorera. Utanga umurimo atanga igihembo, uwikorera arangiza umurimo, maze kwishyura bigakorwa hakoreshejwe QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Ikatalogi ya interineti irimo ibicuruzwa birenga igihumbi. Abaguzi bashobora gushakisha, gutoranya no gutumiza ibintu mu buryo butaziguye kuri WhatsApp.
project.category.ianprem: Iduka rya interineti rya porogaramu zihenze
project.description.ianprem: Iduka rya interineti rya konti za porogaramu zihenze nka Netflix na Spotify. Abaguzi bihitiramo bakishyura ubwabo, naho abayobozi bagacunga ububiko n'ibicuruzwa.
project.category.alengka: Urubuga rw'ikatalogi y'ibikoresho byo mu nzu
project.description.alengka: Ikatalogi ya interineti y'ibikoresho byo mu nzu no hanze ya kafe, resitora n'ingo. Abasura bashobora kureba icyegeranyo no kubaza inama kuri WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Urubuga rwemewe rw'ishuri ribanza rufite umwirondoro w'ishuri, amakuru yo kwakira abanyeshuri bashya, urutonde rw'abarimu, ibikorwa byiyongera ku masomo n'ibyo abanyeshuri bagezeho.
project.category.furnix: Urubuga rw'ikatalogi y'ibikoresho byo mu nzu
project.description.furnix: Ikatalogi ya interineti y'ibikoresho by'ibyuma bivuye i Jepara bya kafe, resitora n'ingo. Abasura bashobora guhitamo ibicuruzwa bakabitumiza uko babishaka.
project.description.clothique: Iduka ryuzuye ry'imyenda kuri interineti: ikatalogi, igitebo cyo guhaha, kwishyura kuri interineti, blog n'ahantu h'ubuyobozi ho gucunga ibyatumijwe na raporo.
project.description.agli: Igikoresho cy'amatsinda akora ibikubiyemo gikusanya ingero z'ibikubiyemo bisurwa cyane, kigaragaza imiterere, kandi kigategura inyandiko nshya.
project.description.nebulist: Umufasha mu kugurisha ukoresha AI ukora ingamba, inyandiko z'abakiriya bashobora kuboneka n'inyandiko z'ubutumwa bwo kubavugisha, hashingiwe ku makuru y'igicuruzwa.
project.description.carbonfi: Porogaramu y'imari ya digitale yo gucuruza ibihembo bya karubone (ibihembo byo kugabanya imyuka) na gahunda z'ibihembo byita ku bidukikije.
project.description.protectedpay: Porogaramu itekanye yo kohereza amafaranga ya digitale: amafaranga arekurwa gusa iyo yakiriwe, hari kwishyura mu itsinda no kuzigama.
project.description.pedulichain: Urubuga rw'impano rukorera mu mucyo: buri mpano n'uko amafaranga akoreshwa byandikwa burundu kandi buri wese arabibona.
project.description.astra: Umufasha wa AI uganira na we gusa kugira ngo ucunge umutungo wa digitale, nko kohereza token cyangwa gukora ibikusanywa bya digitale, nta bumenyi bwo kwandika code ukeneye.
project.description.auditfi: Igikoresho gishingiye kuri AI gisuzuma umutekano wa porogaramu z'imari ya digitale, kikamenya aho zifite intege nke kandi kigakora raporo mu masegonda make.
project.category.p2p: Porogaramu yo guhana umutungo wa digitale
project.description.p2p: Urubuga rwo guhana umutungo wa digitale mu buryo butaziguye hagati y'abakoresha, rufite uburinzi bw'ibikorwa n'ahantu h'ubuyobozi ho gucunga urubuga.
project.description.payguppy: Porogaramu ifasha amaduka asanzwe kwakira kwishyurwa mu mafaranga ya digitale akoresheje QR code asanzwe afite.
project.description.tiptap: Urubuga rw'abakora ibikubiyemo rwo kwakira impano z'abareba mu mafaranga ya digitale cyangwa ibikusanywa bya digitale, rufite ubutumwa bwo kumenyesha mu gihe cy'itangazwa rya live.
project.description.senkus: Umukino wa interineti ushingiye kuri siyansi n'ubumaji bw'ibinyabutabire: abakinnyi bavanga imiti, bakusanya ibikoresho bya digitale kandi bahatana mu rubuga.
project.description.quickstock: Porogaramu ya mudasobwa yo gucunga ububiko bw'iduka ry'imyenda: kwandika ibyagurishijwe, ibyazanywe n'abatanga ibicuruzwa na raporo z'ububiko, hakurikijwe inshingano ya buri mukozi.
project.description.caer: Urubuga rwo gutiza no kuguza umutungo wa digitale hagati y'imiyoboro itandukanye, rushyigikira rupiya ya digitale IDRX, byorohereza kuzigama no kuguza.
